name: rw-b3a-selfupdate-helpers
prompt:
Add helpers at the end of the non-test code, before the `#[cfg(test)]` line at the bottom of the file (patch: SEARCH `#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "selfupdate_tests.rs"]
mod tests;` and REPLACE it with your code followed by those same three lines, then add after them: `#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "selfupdate_replace_tests.rs"]
mod replace_tests;`). Helpers: `/// Name of the runner file the server offers for download.
pub fn asset_name() -> &'static str` returns "kompanion-runner.exe" with `cfg!(windows)`, else "kompanion-runner". `pub fn replace_with_new(new: &Path, target: &Path) -> Result<(), String>`: Windows cannot rename over a running program, but it can rename the running file away. Name `old` = target path with `.old` appended to the file name; remove a stale `old` (ignore errors); rename target to old (error text = e.to_string(), and `new` is left alone); rename new to target; if that fails rename old back to target (ignore its error) and return the first error. If target does not exist yet, skip the first rename. `pub fn cleanup_old(target: &Path)`: remove the `.old` file next to target, ignoring every error. `fn make_executable(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String>`: on unix (`#[cfg(unix)]`) chmod 0o755 via std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt, on windows (`#[cfg(not(unix))]`) Ok(()). `fn put_in_place(new: &Path, target: &Path) -> Result<(), String>`: unix: std::fs::rename(new, target) mapped to e.to_string(); windows: replace_with_new. Give replace_with_new and cleanup_old `#[cfg_attr(unix, allow(dead_code))]` only if cargo warns; the tests exercise them.
check: export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/kk-runwin-target; cd runner && cargo test --quiet selfupdate

name: rw-b3b-selfupdate-install
prompt: In `install_binary`: remove the line `use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;`; replace the `std::fs::set_permissions(&new, ...from_mode(0o755))...?;` line with `make_executable(&new)?;`; replace the final `std::fs::rename(&new, target).map_err(|e| e.to_string())` with `put_in_place(&new, target)`. Change nothing else. In `update_from_server` build `url` as `format!("{}/download/{}", base.trim_end_matches('/'), asset_name())`. Keep every other line.
